record.body:
## Evidence

tests/helpers.py wait_workers falls through without an error when every retry hits WorkerCancelled. tests/test_dashboard_app.py _wait_workers returns on the first WorkerCancelled, so two helpers differ.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared. The reviewer re-run budget is spent.

## Follow-up

The user decides: raise after the retries and merge the two helpers now, or clear the finding.
